combo_label: Moving House × Puppets & Punch and Judy × Stonehenge & Standing Stones

entries.clue: Kind of puppet worn on the fist, the form Mr Punch has taken since the late 1700s
Estimate of what a home would fetch, sought from two or three firms before selling
Carved boy of Collodi's story whose nose grew longer each time he lied
Chalk-cut trench of the first enclosure, its main bank heaped inside it
Hard silcrete boulder from West Woods near Marlborough, dressed into the outer ring
Gas or electricity box whose figures you jot down on your last morning
Red deer digging tool, left in the earthwork, that levered out the chalk
Yellowing documents that once proved a house was yours, a role the register now fills
Solitary leaning block outside the circle, near which the solstice sun comes up
Carved from lime or pine, as a marionette's head and limbs traditionally are
